title: Template shadow audit engine and divergence tracking
body:
TEMPLATE SHADOW AUDIT ENGINE
- Implemented an asynchronous background shadow audit engine that automatically samples fast template matches and compares them with independent Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite AST plans.
- Catches relation, operator, and value mismatches without adding any latency or overhead to player answers.

ADMIN AUDIT PANEL & API
- Added a dedicated "Template Shadow Audit" tab in the Admin Dashboard under QA & Knowledge with status filtering (Open / Reviewed), mode filters, and one-click testing in the QA Playground.
- Created administrative API endpoints (/admin/template-divergences) to inspect and review divergences.
- Added PostgreSQL persistence and Alembic migration for template_divergences.
